subject: PSI-25 Appendix A, tests of Fernandez-Pello, Olson
input:
### P1
Broke -20, -21 igniters, -22 worked; nice flame, got down to extinction at pot 0.315 (finite low flow), very slow increments 7/3/2014 GMT 184 ---------- 55

### P10
HCl 0.3 > 0.9, steady burn at multiple velocities, finite quench at pot 0.3 7/29/14 GMT 210 ---------- 104

### P12
Loss of signal before extinguished, oscillating at 0.36, out immediately at 0.34, multiple steady spread flows 7/14/14 GMT 195 14:30:00 85

### P13a
Fan pot 1.1 (5 cm/s), 0.4, 0.36, 0.32, 0.3, 0.28, 0.26; flame out when pot turned to 0; HCL 0.5 > 4.1; flame reached front of sample and began to wrap around 7/14/14 GMT 195 16:04:00 86

### P13b
Fan pot 1.3 (5 cm/s), 0.4, 0.36, 0.32; flame out when pot turned to 0.32 6/23/2014 ---------- 29

### P14
All blue, extinguished at 0.31 6/23/2014 ---------- 30

### P15
Nice stable burn with sooty tail but blue leading edge 7/22/14 GMT 203 ---------- 93

### P16
Extinguished at pot 0.32, one high flow setting 7/29/14 GMT 210 ---------- 105

### P17
A few finite flows, then tried blowoff without success, turned back down to 2 cm/s, then 0.36, 0.34 pots, oscillated and out at 0.34; leading edge receded slightly but did not blowoff 7/30/14 GMT 211 10:46:00 107

### P18
Alternated fan pot between 1 and 2 at 1-min intervals to try to get time constant resolution; finally turned pot down slowly, extinction at fan pot 0.32 7/22/14 GMT 203 ---------- 94

### P19
Tried blowoff, did not blowoff at pot 10 2 restrictors, flame out at 0.32, sample mostly gone 6/16/2014 ---------- 26

### P2
Nice stable burn at low velocity, mostly blue with some inner soot at higher flow, stable flame at pot 0.33, did not get extinction on stills, but was just fan off, not slow ramp 7/30/14 GMT 211 15:22:22 109

### P20
Alternated fan pot between 1 and 2 at 1-min intervals to try to get time constant resolution; finally turned pot down slowly, extinction at fan pot 0.335 6/23/2014 GMT 174 ---------- 31

### P21a
Flame self-extinguished at 5 cm/s after sample end became flat, dim flame 6/23/2014 ---------- 32

### P21b
Igniter broke after third attempt to ignite flattened end of sample

### P22a
Extinguished at higher flow, possibly rod not preheated enough by a bit, CO readings elevated, slow response 7/8/2014 GMT 189 ---------- 69

### P22b
Extinguished at lower flow than P22a by a bit, longer slower decrease in flow, CO elevated, slow response 7/30/14 GMT 211 16:18:33 110

### P23
Alternated fan pot between 1 and 2 at 1-min then 2-min intervals to try to get time constant resolution; finally turned pot down slowly, extinction at fan pot 0.38 7/30/14 GMT 211 11:13:35 108

### P24
Alternated fan pot between 1 and 2 at 1-min intervals to try to get time constant resolution; finally turned pot down slowly, extinction at fan pot 0.30 7/8/2014 GMT 189 ---------- 70

### P25
Reburn of 217m in opposed geometry, repeat of P22b, extinguished at same 0.31 pot, more sparklers from flame, and less leading edge vapor jetting, or more central jetting; rod warped downward in video view at end of test, asymmetrical instabilities noted briefly at pot change to 0.32, CO elevated, slow response 6/16/2014 ---------- 27

### P3a
Repeat of last test with clear rod; extinguished at 0.3 pot very small flame, but steady spread 6/16/2014 ---------- 28

### P3b
P3b 215M 6.35-mm clear rod -22 2 Opposed ------------ 5, very low (0.85, 0.32, 0.31, 0.305, 0.30, 0.295) 250 ---- NA NA N CL A -4 NA ---- F2 1,000 Cont 9 303 17.4 16.8 16.3 15.7 0.51 failed 33 79 Very low velocity test to get limiting spread rate, pot 0.32 spread, 0.31 spread, etc.; power failed to camera?; fan still running; camera power cable needed repair and taping to camera body to make it work 7/3/2014 GMT 184 ---------- 54

### P4
HCl 0.9 > 1.8, long slow burn, steady at multiple pots until turned off flow 7/14/14 GMT 195 13:18:00 83

### P5
Fan pot 1.5 (5 cm/s), 0.9, 0.4, 0.36, 0.32, 0.308, 0.3, 0.29, 0.28 (flame persisted for all) finally turned down flow to 0 to extinguish; HCL 0 > 4.7; lots of fuel left behind, conical shape 7/3/2014 GMT 184 ---------- 53

### P6
HCl 0 > 0.9, steady burning until turned flow off, multiple pot settings 7/3/2014 GMT 184 ---------- 56

### P8
HCl 0.9 > 0.9, would not stay lit, tip of sample was flat 7/14/14 GMT 195 13:57:00 84

### P9
Fan pot 1.5 (5 cm/s), 0.9, 0.4, 0.36, 0.32, 0.3, 0.28 flame out at 0.28; HCL 4.7 > 4.5; flame did not leave conical portion behind, rather fuel was consumed but final sample shape was very irregular

### O1
Bracket test with decreasing flows; very sooty long flame at high flows; rod very thinned out and was wobbling due to vapor jetting later in test; Rick broke it off holder during readjustments 7/22/14 GMT 203 13:26 95

### O10
Leading edge (LE) blew out at fan 81, 25 s for rest of flame to blowoff at maximum flow 7/8/2014 GMT 189 -------- 65

### O11
Repeat of clear rod O8b test, to compare black versus clear for stagnation flame, blowoff at pot of 6.0, fan slightly higher than O8b, HCl 2.8 7/8/2014 GMT 189 -------- 67

### O12
No sustained flame at any flow, flame with igniter but died immediately upon igniter removal, HCL 12.3 7/21/14 GMT 202 17:22 91

### O13a
Ignited and burned at 5 pot settings, flame self-extinguished after 3+ min at pot 0.31 7/21/14 GMT 202 17:57 92

### O13b
Only stayed lit at 0.9 for less than a minute 8/1/14 GMT 213 16:18:00 117

### O14
Ignition at 5 cm/s then slow pot decreases to quenching pot 0.28 7/28/2014 GMT 209 11:36 msg 100

### O15a
Decrease flow to extinction at 0.32 pot, from 0.35 pot. 1.5 min at 5 cm/s; 2.5 min pot 1.0; 3.5 min at 0.5; 3.5 min 0.35; slow turn down to 0.32, flame out fairly quickly 7/28/2014 GMT 209 11:59:30 msg 101

### O15b
Reburn of same rod as previous; decreased flow to extinction at 0.27 pot, much lower than previous; rod heatup effect? 1 min 5 cm/s; 3.5 min pot 0.5; 5 min 0.35; 4 min 0.34; 4 min 0.33; 3 min 0.32; 1 min 0.31; 1 min 0.3; 1 min 0.29; 1.5 min 0.28; 0.27 out 7/29/14 GMT 210 -------- 106

### O16
Brief flame at end of first ignition, but no joy on sustained flame 7/22/14 GMT 203 -------- 96

### O17
Stable burns at slightly higher flows, LE blowoff at fan 72 and turned down flow but flame did not recover and extinguished even after flow was down to 43-44 7/28/2014 GMT 209 11:05 102

### O18
Got rod hot, blue flame, turned flow up to pot 4.0, stag region blew out, Alex turned down quickly to 1.5 and got it to restabilize; we repeated it but it would not restabilize second time and flame extinguished after multiple oscillations at pot 1.0, after 1.5 would not restabilize 8/1/14 GMT 213 16:49:00 118

### O19
Ignition at 5 cm/s then slow pot decreases to quenching pot 0.288 2/18/14 GMT2014- 049 -------- 6

### O2
Ignited at 2 cm/s, and got dim flame that got sooty with lots of vapor jetting, reduced flow to 1.5 pot and got less vapor jetting test; still sooty at these low flows

### O3a
Flame extinguished as soon as he turned flow down, probably overshot, flame sooty at 5 cm/s -------- 24

### O3b
Flame sooty even at lower flows, didn't get blue until air reading was zero 7/8/2014 GMT 189 -------- 66

### O4
Larger rod, decreased flow, extinguished at 0.36, HCl 9.7 7/21/14 GMT 202 15:59 89

### O5a
Hard to ignite, broke two igniters, burned for 9 min then blew out with pot of 4.0, tried to stay lit but blew off after multiple oscillations. 7/21/14 GMT 202 17:02 90

### O5b
Would not sustain a flame without igniter on, broke igniter again 6/26/2014 -------- 37

### O6
6/26/2014 -------- 38

### O7
Blowoff fan 97, HCl post 4.9 6/26/2014 -------- 39

### O8a
Quench at pot 0.31, HCL 4.8 to 5.9 6/26/2014 -------- 40

### O8b
Blowoff fan 78, HCl prepost 5.9 to 7.9 6/26/2014 -------- 41

### O9
Blowoff fan 68, HCl 7.5 to 9.3
